import sys
import heapq

MAXN = 10000
MAXM = 2000000
INF = 0x3f3f3f3f

class Edge:
    def __init__(self):
        self.to = 0
        self.next = 0
        self.cap = 0
        self.flow = 0
        self.cost = 0

edge = [Edge() for _ in range(MAXM)]
head = [-1 for _ in range(MAXN)]
tol = 0
pre = [-1 for _ in range(MAXN)]
dis = [INF for _ in range(MAXN)]
vis = [False for _ in range(MAXN)]
N = 0

def init(n):
    global N
    N = n
    tol = 0
    for i in range(N):
        head[i] = -1

def addedge(u, v, cap, cost):
    global tol
    edge[tol].to = v
    edge[tol].cap = cap
    edge[tol].cost = cost
    edge[tol].flow = 0
    edge[tol].next = head[u]
    head[u] = tol
    tol += 1
    edge[tol].to = u
    edge[tol].cap = 0
    edge[tol].cost = -cost
    edge[tol].flow = 0
    edge[tol].next = head[v]
    head[v] = tol
    tol += 1

def spfa(s, t):
    q = []
    for i in range(N):
        dis[i] = INF
        vis[i] = False
        pre[i] = -1
    dis[s] = 0
    vis[s] = True
    heapq.heappush(q, (0, s))
    while q:
        u = heapq.heappop(q)[1]
        vis[u] = False
        for i in range(head[u], -1, -1):
            v = edge[i].to
            if edge[i].cap > edge[i].flow and dis[v] > dis[u] + edge[i].cost:
                dis[v] = dis[u] + edge[i].cost
                pre[v] = i
                if not vis[v]:
                    vis[v] = True
                    heapq.heappush(q, (dis[v], v))
    if pre[t] == -1:
        return False
    else:
        return True

def minCostMaxflow(s, t, cost):
    flow = 0
    cost = 0
    while spfa(s, t):
        Min = INF
        for i in range(pre[t], -1, -1):
            if Min > edge[i].cap - edge[i].flow:
                Min = edge[i].cap - edge[i].flow
        for i in range(pre[t], -1, -1):
            edge[i].flow += Min
            edge[i ^ 1].flow -= Min
            cost += edge[i].cost * Min
        flow += Min
    return flow

def main():
    global N
    n, m, k, c, d = map(int, input().split())
    init(MAXN)
    for i in range(k):
        x = int(input())
        addedge(0, x, 1, 0)
    for i in range(100):
        for j in range(k):
            addedge(1 + i * n, 9999, 1, i * c)
    for i in range(m):
        u, v = map(int, input().split())
        for j in range(1, 100):
            for gg in range(1, k + 1):
                addedge(u + (j - 1) * n, v + j * n, 1, (2 * gg - 1) * d)
                addedge(v + (j - 1) * n, u + j * n, 1, (2 * gg - 1) * d)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(1, 100):
            addedge(i + (j - 1) * n, i + j * n, k, 0)
    cost = 0
    minCostMaxflow(0, 9999, cost)
    print(cost)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
